shared_elements: horizontal band dividing the surface into registers
row of repeated enclosed motifs (cartouche-like or arch-like units) along a band
zigzag/hatched linear filler pattern within a band
row of creatures aligned side by side facing one direction
justification: Both surfaces organise flat, outlined low-relief figures into registers divided by a horizontal band that carries a row of repeated enclosed units and zigzag/hatched filler, and both place a line of profile creatures side by side above or below that band. But the actual subjects differ fundamentally: A shows costumed anthropomorphic figures with headdresses seated around a central emblem, while B shows only animals (a quadruped, birds, a snake-like form) with no human figures and no interaction between them.
